## Purpose
Live progress for ordinary requests: deploy, ingest, test, validate, clean up. A request tagged with an `X-Op-Id` header publishes what it is doing (stages, pipeline layers, model calls, log lines). The browser follows it at `GET /api/ops/{id}/events` (SSE). Outside a tagged request every function does nothing.

## Responsibilities
Re-exports from `tracker`: current, detach, note, part, pipeline_event, registry, report, stage, step_begin and step_end.

## Key elements
The re-exports.

- **The middleware** binds the op. `routes` (ops) streams it.
- **Code anywhere reports into it:** codegen, layers, tool_resolver and others.
